_schema: Every numeric entry is {v, unit, conf, src, note?}. Units: mm and deg, in the machine frame (Blender, Z up): origin at the centre of the case footprint on the table under its feet (the base's bottom face is at Z = 2.5, the feet's height), +X left to right as the operator sees the keyboard, +Y toward the back, +Z up. The case runs from Y = -135 (the lid's front edge) to Y = +135 (the back). 'yf' means a distance back from the lid's front edge (Y = yf - 135). conf: meas = measured on a real CEC-I (caliper or ruler); photo = scaled from photographs of it; est = an estimate; design = our own choice where the machine does not say. keyboard.json is generated from this file by model/tools/make_keyboard.py, board.json from the main board's photograph by model/tools/make_board.py; never edit them by hand.
reference_machine: A CEC-I, serial 87010305, made by Shanghai No. 4 Radio Factory (Kaige), main board ZH-1(875), late 1987

The raised part is narrower than the keyboard part by side_overhang each side, and flush with the base.
